summary: The Schur jet is a combination, with integral coefficients y, of jets along products of minors (`sum_schur_smul_nablaBasis`), and is controlled by a jet of Θ composed with linear forms. Choose the integral frames M of `exists_null_coupling_frames` for the coefficients y: the substituted family z = p^g·M·y is null, so by IsIntegralOnNullCone the coefficients of Θ(ϖz) of degree ≤ B are integral. The jet along the product of minors equals a jet of Θ(ϖz) times a factor whose norm is ≥ |θ|^{coupling}·|ϖ|^B·p^{−m}. A jet of Θ(ϖz) along a monomial of exponent d (degree B) is d!·(an integral coefficient), and for B > 0 the factor from ∏_x d_x! has norm at most p^{−B/(p−1) + |Φ|N³(⌊log_p B⌋+1)} (Legendre: v_p(d_x!) ≥ d_x/(p−1) − (⌊log_p B⌋+1), at most |Φ|N³ variables): the factorials gain p^{−B/(p−1)} and lose at most p^{|Φ|N³(⌊log_p B⌋+1)}. (At B = 0 the bound of the statement, with Lean's Nat.log p 0 = 0, holds as well.)

steps.claim: (Lines 69–71 end the statement: the line census takes the `:=` of `let N := card n'` for the start of the value, so the rest of the statement is owned here.)
Introduce N, B, m and the hypothesis hV (null-cone integrality up to degree B); L := the additive map F ↦ jet of Θ along F.
steps.lean: intro N B m hV; let L := ((jet _).flip Θ).toAddMonoidHom

steps.claim: By `exists_val_coeff_le_val_eval`, choose integral values y of the variables such that the valuation of an integral combination is controlled by its value at y; with `sum_schur_smul_nablaBasis` the Schur jet is an integral combination of jets along products of minors evaluated at y, so it suffices to bound |L(product of minors at y)|.
steps.lean:
refine (exists_val_coeff_le_val_eval valuation ![AddMonoidAlgebra.map L _]).elim fun (y : _ →
    valRingCp p) h ↦ .trans (coord_mem_of_coeff_mem ((valuation.leAddSubgroup _).comap L) _
    (sum_schur_smul_nablaBasis hκ ..) (h 0) _) ?_
have : 1 < p := Fact.out

steps.claim: Frames M from `exists_null_coupling_frames` for the data y and θ.
steps.lean: choose M hM hA using exists_null_coupling_frames pr S N κ ev (y ⟨⟨·, ·⟩, ·⟩) θ

steps.claim: z(τ, b, a)(o) := p^{g(τ, h, b)}·(M_{τ,h} row · y_{τ,a}) if o matches (τ, b), else 0.
steps.lean:
let z := fun (τ, b, a) (o : (Σ h : Fin N, Fin h) × _) ↦
    ite (o.2 = (τ, b)) (p ^ g τ o.1.1 b * M τ _ o.1.2 ⬝ᵥ (y ⟨⟨τ, a⟩, ·⟩)) 0

steps.claim: The family linearSeries∘z is null (no constant term; its Frobenius couplings vanish modulo p and θ by (ii) of the frames, the exempted couplings being killed by the charge p^g ≡ 0); so hV applies to it.
steps.lean:
specialize hV (linearSeries ∘ z) (by simp) fun φ h0 j hj ↦ by
    simp [sum_pow_char_pow, Finset.sum_mul_sum, MvPowerSeries.smul_eq_C_mul, mul_pow,
      mul_mul_mul_comm _ (_ ^ _), @sum_comm _ _ (Φ × _), ← sum_mul]
    exact sum_eq_zero fun o _ ↦ sum_eq_zero fun q _ ↦
      flip id (hA (φ.comp _) h0 ⟨j, hj⟩ o.2.1 o.1.2 q.1.2) (by simp [apply_ite, CharP.cast_eq_zero,
      z, NeZero.ne, zero_pow_eq, sum_prod_type, Prod.ext_iff, ↓mul_comm (_ ^ _)]; grind +splitImp)

steps.claim: hc: |θ|^{coupling}·(|ϖ|^B·p^{−m}) ≤ |∏ (det M_{τ,h})ᵀ·∏ ϖ·p^{g}|, from (i) of the frames.
steps.lean:
have hc : _ * (‖ϖ‖ ^ B * (↑p)⁻¹ ^ m) ≤ ‖∏ τ, ∏ h : Fin N, ∏ j, (valRingCp p).subtype
    (M τ h)ᵀ.det * ∏ b, ϖ * p ^ g τ h ((i' τ).1 h j b)‖ := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hM
    (by positivity)).trans (by simp [B, m, Fintype.prod_sigma, norm_p_eq_inv, ← pow_mul])
steps.typed_fact:
_ * (‖ϖ‖ ^ B * (↑p)⁻¹ ^ m) ≤ ‖∏ τ, ∏ h : Fin N, ∏ j, (valRingCp p).subtype
    (M τ h)ᵀ.det * ∏ b, ϖ * p ^ g τ h ((i' τ).1 h j b)‖

steps.claim: Rewrite the evaluation of L at y as L applied to the evaluation, and multiply the goal by the positive factor of hc.
steps.lean:
erw [(by simp [eval, eval₂, Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index, L, map_finsuppSum, C_eq_smul_one,
    mul_comm] : ∀ y f, eval y (AddMonoidAlgebra.map L f) = L (eval (C ∘ y) f)),
    ← mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (hc.trans_lt' (hϖ ▸ hπ ▸ by positivity)), ← norm_smul,
      ← LinearMap.map_smul₂]

steps.claim: The scaled product of minors equals the linear substitution (ϖ·z) of the product of determinants of variable matrices (shown at the end); by `jet_subst_linearSeries` the jet becomes a jet of Θ(ϖz).
steps.lean:
grw [← hc, (?_ : _ • _ = linSubst (of (ϖ * z · ·)) (∏ τ, ∏ h : Fin N, ∏ j, (of fun b i ↦
    X (⟨h, i⟩, τ, (i' τ).1 h j b)).det)), ← jet_subst_linearSeries]

steps.claim: Expand the determinants (Leibniz formula) into a sum of monomials.
steps.lean:
simp only [det_apply, Fintype.prod_sum, X, ← monomial_sum_one, of_apply, prod_smul, map_sum,
    LinearMap.sum_apply]

steps.claim: Bound the sum by the maximum of its terms (ultrametric).
steps.lean: apply norm_sum_le_of_forall_le_of_nonneg (by positivity)

steps.claim: For one monomial, let d be its exponent.
steps.lean: intros; set d : _ →₀ ℕ := Finset.sum ..

steps.claim: B = deg d.
steps.lean: have e : B = d.degree := by simp [d, B, mul_comm]

steps.claim: For each variable x, Legendre's formula bounds v_p(d_x!) from below in terms of d_x/(p − 1) and ⌊log_p B⌋ + 1 (d_x ≤ B < p^{⌊log_p B⌋+1}; `padicValNat_factorial_mem_Icc`).
steps.lean:
apply flip id (d.support.sum_le_sum fun x _ ↦ (padicValNat_factorial_mem_Icc
    ((d.le_degree x).trans_lt (p.lt_pow_succ_log_self this _))).1)

steps.claim: Write the jet as d! times a coefficient of Θ(ϖz), norms via p-adic valuations.
steps.lean: simp [norm_natCast_eq_inv_pow_padicValNat, smul_sum, smul_smul] at hV ⊢

steps.claim: Use hV at d (degree ≤ B): the coefficient is integral; the number of variables is at most |Φ|·N³.
steps.lean:
grw +useKAbstract [hV e.ge, card_le_univ, card_prod, Fintype.card_sigma,
    sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ N (by simp)]

steps.claim: Combine the exponents (linear arithmetic).
steps.lean:
simpa [*, m, d.degree_apply, ← sum_div, ← rpow_mul, ← rpow_add, this.pos, ← rpow_neg,
    ← rpow_natCast p, ← rpow_mul_natCast] using (by linear_combination ·)

steps.claim: The identity of step 10: the product of minors scaled by the frames is the substitution of the product of determinants (multiplicativity of det, minors of products).
steps.lean:
simp only [nablaBasis, tableauPoly, minor, map_prod, AlgHom.map_det, RingHom.map_det, N,
    smul_eq_C_mul, ← prod_mul_distrib, map_mul, mul_rotate (det _), ← det_mul_column, ← det_mul]

steps.claim: Entrywise comparison.
steps.lean: congr!; ext

steps.claim: Each entry agrees after expanding the substitution.
steps.lean:
simp [z, linSubst, sum_prod_type, smul_eq_C_mul, mul_sum, rowSubst, sum_mul, entrywise,
    @sum_comm n, apply_ite, mul_assoc, mul_comm (X _), mul_left_comm (C (M ..).1)]
